recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, symmetrical illustration featuring a three-headed, multi-armed cybernetic figure inspired by Da Vinci's Vitruvian Man, set against a massive, intricate circular gear mechanism. The figure is rendered in high-sheen chrome with visible skeletal and mechanical components, while the background consists of weathered bronze and copper industrial machinery.
coreVisualRelationships: Central chrome figure contrasted against a dark, warm-toned industrial background
Radial symmetry established by the circular gear and the multi-limbed pose
Large-scale metallic typography overlapping the top of the central mechanism
Secondary smaller text aligned horizontally at the very top edge
coreInvariants: Three-headed central figure with multiple arms and legs
Circular gear frame containing the central subject
High-contrast specular highlights on metallic surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cybernetic figure is centered and occupies approximately 60% of the vertical space within a large circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central three-headed face of the chrome figure, which serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central heads, move outward along the multiple arms to the circular gear, then upward to the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with mechanical detail, with dark shadows providing depth between gears.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep bronze and rust browns for the background machinery and circular frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool silver and bright chrome for the central figure and main title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle magenta and purple glows emanating from the mechanical joints and background gaps.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright white-silver highlights and the deep black shadows of the industrial depths.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to metallic tones and dark industrial hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with aggressive horizontal expansion
letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal bars with sharp, angular terminals
Integrated chrome texture with beveled edges
Top bar of letters often connects or forms a continuous shelf
Strong perspective tilt or slight arc following the circular frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'H' feature elongated horizontal strokes that frame the word
Internal counters are narrow and geometric
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact metallic custom lettering paired with a minimalist, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for technical contrast.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, industrial feel of the display text
Appropriate for the technical, sci-fi aesthetic of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed airbrush-style illustration of a three-headed chrome cybernetic Vitruvian man inside a giant bronze gear mechanism. Use dark industrial tones with magenta light leaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide, chrome-textured, beveled sans-serif display text across the top third, slightly arched. Add a secondary line of widely-spaced orange geometric text at the very top margin.

verificationChecks: Is the central figure chrome and three-headed?
Is the display text beveled and metallic?
Is the background a circular gear assembly?
Is the color palette dominated by bronze and silver?

adjustableVariables: Number of heads/limbs on the central figure
Intensity of the magenta light glows
Complexity of the background gear teeth
Degree of arch in the display typography
mustRedesign: Remove any specific barcodes or price stickers
Replace specific band/album names with generic sci-fi placeholders
Ensure the chrome rendering is distinct from existing commercial logos

mustAchieve: Intricate mechanical detail in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen consistency across the figure and text
Verify the radial symmetry of the gear mechanism
Ensure the three heads are clearly defined and integrated
Confirm the orange text is legible against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cybernetic Vitruvian Man] + [Bronze Industrial Gear Frame] + [Chrome Beveled Typography] + [80s Airbrush Finish]
